Soon we'll all be speaking^\255\003^well, English, I guess.
Maybe you should switch to decaf.
No!  Then I'd fall asleep, and^
We're living mostly on the income from renting out our mansion.
That and Edna's tips from her exotic dancing.
I got the contract for you to sign, Doctor!
Sorry, I don't like to sign things I haven't read.
Will you PLEASE sign this contract?
I don't sign things I haven't read.
But the whole human race is at risk!
Sign it or^ I'll^ get real mad.
Oh, forget it.  I'll get rid of Purple Tentacle myself!
And do what?\255\003Not be my friend anymore?
I'm getting Purple Tentacle declared insane and arrested.
I'm starting up a petition to ban all tentacles.
I offered Purple Tentacle a bribe and he took it.
I guess I can't.  Hey, did you join a record club lately?
But I need a note signed by a doctor^
Where'd you get that kind of money?
I used one of your checks.
Brilliant!  I'll just stop payment on it tomorrow!
Exactly!  All I need now is your signature^
Good God, no!\255\003Those things are horrible, money-leeching death traps!
Well, there's a deliveryman upstairs with a carton of easy-listening eight-tracks for you^\255\003^he says you have to pay for them^
^unless you sign this refusal form immediately^
I'm busy trying to think of a way to save humanity!
Of course!  That's why I'm busy trying to think of a way to save it!
Thanks!  That was a close one.
I don't have time to read!
We wait for those buddies of yours to plug in their Johns!
We have to buy a diamond and plug it into the Chron-O-John!
According to my instruments, everything is in readiness!\255\003Your friends have activated their units, so it's time to^\255\003THROW THE SWITCH!
I'm so glad you two made it back ok!
I hate to interrupt, but there's no time to lose!\255\003Now that you're back, we've got to proceed with the original plan and send you back to yesterday to turn off the Sludge-O-Matic\015.
Now, hold on a minute, Dr. Fred.\255\003They just barely made it back to our time alive, and I think--
You can't turn off the machine if I get there FIRST!
This time I KNOW I can stop him!
I guess we'd better do something.
You can't all go in the same stall!
Stuck here the rest of my life^\255\003^listening to Bernard talking and watching Hoagie eat.
Mom warned me there'd be days like this.
I believe he's trying to warn you about ME.
We're going to turn off the Sludge-O-Matic\015 and defeat your evil plans, you overgrown WORM.
You sorry lot are no match for ME!
But there's THREE of us--\255\003--well, sort of!
Nevertheless, I mean to crush you.
You see, I've been busy.\255\003These are all versions of myself from the future.\255\003I've been bringing them back here using the Chron-O-John.\255\003Together, we will CONQUER THE WORLD!!
Go to the basement and guard the Sludge-O-Matic\015.
No one is to touch the Sludge-O-Matic\015.
Now, creature, I must decide what excruciating tortures to--
I've been itching for a chance to test out my newly completed DIMINUATOR!
All right, the rest of you come with me!\255\003Next stop^\255\003^THE WORLD!
The battery must not have had time to recharge^\255\003^but it will!
You humans amount to very LITTLE.
Run all you like, you insignificant insect!
